catalogue_snapshot.freeze_rule: Positions, names, and families reproduce the named entries visible in the official catalogue on the snapshot date. Duplicate official entries remain separate rows.

comparison_policy.rule: Compare documented user outcomes within an explicitly bounded QuickPLS scope; do not claim copied internals, numerical identity, full parity, or SmartPLS project compatibility.
comparison_policy.competitive_scope: All non-legacy catalogue entries are in the QuickPLS 3.0 competitor scope. Legacy GoF is intentionally deferred and must remain disclosed.
comparison_policy.status_source_of_truth: release-qualified and native-qualified rows must be backed by the current QuickPLS 3 parity ledger; engine-preview rows require repository implementation evidence but are not accepted native workflows.

target_releases.objective: Establish signed distribution, installer lifecycle certification, and release operations.
Promote current native and assessment capabilities to release-qualified evidence.
Complete diagnostic and extended-relationship native workflows.
Add power analysis and consistent inference/MGA.
Add model comparison/selection and advanced CB-SEM workflows.
Run the signed external competitor beta.
Publish the competitor-grade stable release after every claim gate passes.
Reassess explicitly deferred legacy or low-value methods.

competitor_claim_gate.applies_to: Every method where competitor_scope is true.
competitor_claim_gate.readiness_rule: Commercial readiness is derived only by the fail-closed release-readiness validator. Final competitor approval is a later non-circular envelope that cryptographically binds the current catalogue, validated reports, and full method-manifest set; this planning catalogue contains no editable completion flags.
